name: dhee-runner-minimax-h3
description: MiniMax H3 (Hailuo 03) Reference-to-Video runner for Dhee: comfy.minimax_h3_r2v renders ONE multi-cut clip of up to 15s with native stereo audio from up to 9 reference plates, on a local ComfyUI. Pure TS + ffmpeg; the graph lives in the bundle.

scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/h3.test.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
